responsibility: This implementation module is the core exception engine for GNU Modula-2. It maintains the active EHBlock, per-exception handler tables, exception-state flags, and textual error buffers; formats raised exceptions with file, line, column, scope, and message information; invokes installed handlers or THROW-based propagation; installs the default language exception hooks through SysExceptions; and provides helper raisers for each base Modula-2 exception category. It underpins M2EXCEPTION and the exception-entry procedures exported by M2RTS.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the runtime engine behind the RTExceptions pair: unlike RTExceptions.def, it defines EHBlock and handler storage, tracks the current exception block/state/source, formats exception text, dispatches handlers or THROW, and installs the base Modula-2 exception raisers.
